production.note: US model years. First year rests on Kelley Blue Book (database): the 2025 trim list includes "Mercedes-AMG SL SL 63 S E Performance" (805 hp), while the 2024 list (kbb-2024-amg-sl-specs) has only SL 43, SL 55 and SL 63 Touring/Performance trims. No Mercedes-Benz USA page stating the first US model year was found. Still on sale: mbusa.com lists the 2026 model (mbusa-2026-sl63-se); KBB lists it for 2026 (kbb-2026-amg-sl-specs). The non-hybrid SL 63 is a separate record.

body.note: Sold as the "AMG SL 63 S E PERFORMANCE Roadster" ("Passenger capacity 4"), a soft-top with no fixed-roof version; Roadster as in the SL 63 (R232) record. C/D panel: "2+2-passenger, 2-door convertible".

configuration.note: "Handcrafted AMG 4.0L V8 biturbo w/rear 150kW electric motor".

displacementL.note: "4.0L"; the C/D panel also says "4.0-liter" (cd-amg-sl63-se-2026). No cc figure was given on the pages opened.

aspiration.note: "V8 biturbo"; panel: "twin-turbocharged and intercooled DOHC 32-valve 4.0-liter V-8".

fuel.note: Panel: "5-kWh lithium-ion battery pack; peak charge rate, AC: 3.7 kW" (chargeable from the grid).

drivetrain.note: "Drive configuration AMG Performance 4MATIC+ all-wheel drive"; panel: "front-engine, rear-motor, all-wheel-drive".

transmission.note: "Automatic transmission AMG SPEEDSHIFT® MCT 9-speed" (recorded as Automatic as in the other AMG MCT records). The rear electric motor has its own two-speed gearbox (panel: "Transmissions: 9-speed automatic/2-speed automatic").

powerHp.note: Combined system output. Quote (mbusa.com, 2026 model): "Power 805 hp @ 5,500-6,500 rpm". C/D panel: "(combined output: 805 hp, 1047 lb-ft; 5-kWh lithium-ion battery pack; peak charge rate, AC: 3.7 kW)" (cd-amg-sl63-se-2026). KBB 2025: "805 @ 5500 RPM" (kbb-2025-amg-sl-specs).

weightLb.note: Manufacturer US curb weight (weight-order step 1), 2026 model, 9-speed MCT (the only transmission). Quote (mbusa.com): "Curb weight 4,839 lbs"; no estimate label. Car and Driver's road-test curb weight of a 2026 test car is 4,811 lb (cd-amg-sl63-se-2026; see discrepancies). Reference year 2026: the earliest year with a manufacturer weight; 805 hp has applied since 2025.

discrepancies.reason: Manufacturer US curb weight vs Car and Driver's measured test car (optioned) and Kelley Blue Book's database figure (4,850 lb, the same figure MBUSA gives for the AMG GT 63 S E Performance coupe).
discrepancies.resolution: Used the manufacturer figure, 4,839 lb (weight-order step 1). The three figures are within 0.8%.
